scientific_integrity: Analytic matrix inversion and factor-sign proof; finite exact symbolic tests are supplementary and not a proof by enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight \(K_{m,3}\), \(m\ge3\), exactly three leaders with common finite positive gain; other graph families/gains not classified. Equivalence to an unindexed prior specialization remains possible.
title: Sharp gain-driven relocation of three noisy leaders on complete bipartite networks
